# prismasdwan_resource_locator (Resource)

Looks up the ID of an existing Prisma SD-WAN configuration object by matching one of its attributes. Useful for referencing objects that are not managed by this provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type` (String) The provider resource type to look up, e.g. `prismasdwan_site`.

### Optional

- `resource_property` (String) Name of the object attribute to match against, e.g. `name`.
- `resource_property_value` (String) Value of the attribute to match.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters used to locate the object, managed automatically by the provider.

### Read-Only

- `result` (String) The resolved ID of the matching object.
